newsitem.title: USA: NBC wins weekly Nielsen ratings again.
newsitem.headline: NBC wins weekly Nielsen ratings again.

text.p: General Electric Co unit NBC again took the top spot attracting evening-hours audiences during the week of June 2 through June 8, Nielsen Media Research said Tuesday.
According to Nielsen, Westinghouse Electric Corp's CBS held second place and Walt Disney Co's ABC network was third in the number of homes tuned in to evening-hours programs.
The FOX network owned by News Corp Ltd was fourth.
-- NBC drew an average 10.2 rating, or percentage of America's approximately 97 million homes with televisions, and a 19 percent share of homes watching television during those hours;
-- CBS had a rating of 7.6 on average and a 14 percent share of homes watching television;
-- ABC's average rating was 6.4 and its share was 12 percent;
-- FOX had a 5.1 rating and a nine percent share of audiences;
-- UPN, a unit of Chris-Craft Industries allied with Viacom Inc, had a rating of 2.7 percent and a share of five percent;
-- WB, a unit of Time-Warner Inc, had a 2.2 rating and a four percent share.
